name: business-logic
description: Convert a product request into explicit rules, states, permissions, exceptions, and verifiable acceptance criteria.

name: catch-up
description: Reconstruct the current project state, completed work, blockers, and next action.

name: core-thinking
description: Analyze goals, constraints, risks, and evidence before execution.

name: design-thinking
description: Frame a problem, clarify the desired outcome, compare simple solutions, and define success before implementation.

name: graft
description: This repo is indexed by graft/. For ANY task here, whether understanding how something works, finding where code lives, tracing what calls a symbol or what a change breaks, or scoping an edit, get your context from graft before grepping or reading source files.

name: loop
description: Continue a bounded task across runs with checkpoints, verification, retries, and explicit stop conditions.

name: session-handoff
description: Produce a compact continuation packet with the next action and verification commands.

name: use-browser
description: Open a supplied URL, understand the user's requested outcome from the live page, complete the browser task, and verify the result.

name: verification
description: Turn implementation claims into focused, repeatable verification checks.
